name: trade-bot
description: Crypto volatility-tracking trading bot — VWAP-deviation spike detector with flow classification and a central risk gate.

scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.audit:ci: pnpm audit --audit-level=high --prod --json > audit-prod.json || true; pnpm --filter @bot/engine exec ts-node tests/ci/runScaGate.ts "$PWD/audit-prod.json"; status=$?; rm -f audit-prod.json; exit $status
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/docs/check-links.mjs && node scripts/docs/check-staleness.mjs && node scripts/docs/check-adr-integrity.mjs
